chapter: Buck and Bubbles: Nazarro and Bubbles
title: Nat Nazarro and Sons, the balancing act
summary: Green says Nazarro bought Buck and Bubbles' contract from Ramon Novarro and had been the bottom man in his own family balancing act.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Did he train Buck and Bubbles in the same way?

I don't think so, no. No, he bought Buck and Bubbles from Ramon Navarro, see, they were under contract to Ramon Navarro, that's what he told us, and he bought the contract, see? Buck and Bubbles used to make them little movies, you know. When they was children, you see.
They was in his act. Nat Nazarra had a -- he was a world famous act, you know, Nat Nazarra and Sons, see. He had five sons, see? They had a balancing act, see?
Yes. Performing, you see, performing. He was perfecting that.

Oh Yeah. He was like what you call the -- he was the bottom man, see. His sons used to run up on his shoulders and on top of him, and he'd balance all of them up on his shoulders, you see. He showed us a scrapbook, you see, where he would pick up one son, be laying down with his hand out, and he'd reach down and grab his hand and pick him straight up, like that. Straight out.
So he actually had a sense of acrobatics himself.
And was he giving you sort of pointers, in terms of acrobatic tap?
